for_loop.quote: The outer loop finishes first; so i ends at 2, then the inner loop runs j from 1 to 3: 2 1, 2 2, 2 3
for_loop.rule: wrong rule: A pass of a loop may leave out one of its parts (the condition test, the body, the update, or the initialization). Right rule: Each pass of a for loop runs test, then body, then update, every time; the initialization runs once, at the start.

loop_scope.quote: The outer loop finishes first; so i ends at 2, then the inner loop runs j from 1 to 3: 2 1, 2 2, 2 3
loop_scope.rule: wrong rule: i declared in the for header can still be used after the loop has ended. Right rule: i declared in the for header exists only inside the loop, so using it after the loop does not compile.

nested_loops.quote: The outer loop finishes first; so i ends at 2, then the inner loop runs j from 1 to 3: 2 1, 2 2, 2 3
nested_loops.rule: wrong rule: The outer loop runs completely, then the inner loop runs completely. Right rule: The inner loop runs all its passes during each single pass of the outer loop.
